title: 6.1 Buildings and Services
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Recognize and name six high-frequency town buildings and services.
grammar_function: Identify places with This is / It is and reuse next to in one supported location sentence.
prerequisite: 2.1 Places Around Me, 2.2 Streets and Transportation, 2.5 This and That; 4.3 Where Things Are.
speaking_outcome: Say the six place names as complete a/the noun chunks.
